scripts.text: Are you going into the forest?
Well, well, well, aren't you being too rash?
scripts.translation: 哎呀呀，你是不是太鲁莽了？

scripts.text: Why don't you at least organize a party?
...Are you sure you're not doing too much?
scripts.translation: ...你确定自己没有勉强过头吗？

scripts.text: I think you'd better get some rest.
scripts.translation: 我觉得你最好休息一下。

scripts.text: You'll only wear yourself out by trying to do too much
scripts.translation: 勉强做太多只会把自己累垮。

scripts.text: I don't think the authority will give you permission, either.
scripts.translation: 我觉得当局也不会批准你进入。

scripts.text: ...Even a Sapha would be stopped from entering the forest.
scripts.translation: ...就连萨帕族人也会被阻止进入森林。

scripts.text: You speak our language quite well, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你把我们的语言说得真好啊？

scripts.text: Actually I'm not speaking your language.
scripts.translation: 其实我说的不是你的语言。

scripts.text: But it's one of the mysteries of Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 不过，这正是毕尤尔特的奥秘之一。

scripts.text: That we can understand each other even if we speak different languages.
scripts.translation: 即使说着不同的语言，我们也能彼此理解。

scripts.text: To be able to talk with everybody...
Perhaps that's the power of Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 或许这就是毕尤尔特的力量。

scripts.text: Now the forest won't reject you.
scripts.translation: 现在森林不会再排斥你了。

scripts.text: What are you going to do now?

scripts.translation: 你们人类冒险者真了不起。

scripts.text: You're always going into the forest, where no one else dares to go.
scripts.translation: 你们总是进入其他人不敢踏足的森林。

scripts.text: Phew. But I have to report to the authority
scripts.translation: 呼。不过我必须向当局报告

scripts.text: everyone who goes into the forest, just in case.
scripts.translation: 每个进入森林的人，以防万一。

scripts.text: Are you going to venture into the Hazy Forest?
The atmosphere is somewhat tense in the forest.
scripts.translation: 森林里的气氛有些紧张。

scripts.text: ...Why don't you just go back today?
I've got it. I've written them down on the report here.
scripts.translation: 明白了。我已经把它们记在这份报告里。

scripts.text: Now go to the log tunnel, the only way to get into the Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation: 现在去木头隧道吧，那是进入雾之森林的唯一通道。

scripts.text: We can't go against the forest,

scripts.translation: 不过也许你们人类可以。

scripts.text: Well, you've made the right decision.

scripts.translation: 这才是对你有好处的选择。

scripts.text: I see you've been into the forest before.
Okay, at least the forest won't reject you.
scripts.translation: 好吧，至少森林不会排斥你。

scripts.text: Put yourself in my shoes, the entrance guard, and let me meet the representative of your party.
scripts.translation: 换位想想，作为入口守卫，我得见见你们队伍的代表。

scripts.text: I have to discuss some things with him/her.
scripts.translation: 我有些事情要和他/她商量。

scripts.text: I see the forest through the log tunnel.
scripts.translation: 我透过木头隧道看见了森林。

scripts.text: It looks like I can enter the forest through the log tunnel.
scripts.translation: 看起来我可以从木头隧道进入森林。

scripts.text: Something doesn't feel right. Looks like something dangerous is going on, so you'd better turn back today.
scripts.translation: 感觉不太对劲。里面似乎发生了危险的事，你今天最好先回去。

scripts.text: You try to crawl into the log, but some mysterious power pushes you back with a gush of wind.
scripts.translation: 你试着爬进木头里，却被一股神秘力量伴随着狂风推了回来。

scripts.text: It seems like you can't force your way into the forest.
scripts.translation: 看来你无法强行进入森林。

scripts.text: Team up with some friends and go together!
The world beyond the log tunnel looks dark and suffocating.
scripts.translation: 木头隧道另一端的世界一片昏暗，令人窒息。

scripts.text: Your instinct is screaming that this forest is dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你的直觉正大声警告你：这座森林很危险。

scripts.text: Obviously no one is taking care of it.
It seems like you can chop down the garden tree.
scripts.translation: 看起来你可以砍倒园中的树。

placeholders: ((getarg(3,0))?"clearing the way out of the forest.":"so now you can continue.")
scripts.text: You chop down the tree, which was blocking the path of the maze, {0}
scripts.translation: 你砍倒了挡在迷宫道路上的树，{0}

scripts.text: Huh? Do you plan to pass through here?
scripts.translation: 嗯？你打算从这里通过吗？

scripts.text: .....I'm afraid it's beyond your ability, but I won't meddle in your affairs.
scripts.translation: ...恐怕这超出你的能力范围，不过我不会干涉你的事。

scripts.text: We'll meet again, if you survive.
scripts.translation: 如果你能活下来，我们还会再见。

scripts.text: You... I remember seeing you at the camp.
scripts.translation: 你...我记得在营地见过你。

scripts.text: The information you gave on Ahat was useful.
scripts.translation: 你提供的关于阿哈特的情报很有用。

scripts.text: But do you plan to pass through here?
scripts.translation: 不过你打算从这里通过吗？

scripts.text: What good is it to go across Bifrost?
scripts.translation: 穿过毕尤尔特有什么好处？

scripts.text: Do you plan to pass through here?
I will advise against it if you're just curious.
scripts.translation: 如果你只是好奇，我劝你别去。

scripts.text: It will only bring about your untimely death...
If you are determined to pass through here,
scripts.translation: 如果你执意要从这里通过，

scripts.text: I will ask for your help with something.
Do you plan to pass through this forest?
scripts.translation: 你打算穿过这片森林吗？

scripts.text: Then I'll ask you a question.
Have you ever seen a guard... a girl with purple hair?
scripts.translation: 你见过一位守卫吗...一个紫发女孩？

scripts.text: Now we have to say goodbye here.
scripts.translation: 我们现在只能在这里道别了。

scripts.text: If you survive this forest, of course.
scripts.translation: 当然，前提是你能活着穿过这片森林。

scripts.text: Step back if you aren't ready.

scripts.translation: 这片森林不欢迎陌生人。

scripts.text: I told you - step back if you don't want to die.
scripts.translation: 我说过了——不想死就退后。

scripts.text: It's not easy going through the forest.
scripts.translation: 穿过这片森林并不容易。

scripts.text: It may cost you your life.
Loki nods slightly and then looks away. -
scripts.translation: 洛基微微点头，随后移开了视线。-

scripts.text: Have you ever seen a guard... a girl with purple hair?
scripts.translation: 你见过一位守卫吗...一个紫发女孩？

scripts.text: Now we have to say goodbye here.
scripts.translation: 我们现在只能在这里道别了。

scripts.text: Hopefully, we will see each other again in Mora.
scripts.translation: 希望我们能在莫拉再见。

scripts.text: I don't want to go with you.
Hopefully, we will see each other again in Mora.
scripts.translation: 希望我们能在莫拉再见。

scripts.text: Are you used to this place?
Come to the inn in Mora.
I have something to give to you.
We're seeing a lot of each other these days.
It seems you are completely comfortable with the place.
scripts.translation: 看来你已经完全适应这里了。

scripts.text: You'd better not be too proud of yourself.
You can go to Mora through this forest.
scripts.translation: 穿过这片森林就能到莫拉。

scripts.text: Is it you that took care of this unruly girl?
scripts.translation: 是你照看了这个任性的女孩吗？

scripts.text: I guess I have to thank you.
You might be able to change your appearance, but you cannot change your unique, innate light.
scripts.translation: 你或许能改变外貌，却无法改变与生俱来的独特光芒。

scripts.text: A scent strong enough to burn your nose.
This is Nydhogg, the Guardian of Yggdrasil,
scripts.translation: 这位是尼德霍格，世界树的守护者，

scripts.text: Now she won't wander around crazy any more.
scripts.translation: 现在她不会再发疯似地四处游荡了。

scripts.text: What are you going to do now?
I'll wait for her to wake up and get out of this forest.
scripts.translation: 我会等她醒来，再带她离开森林。

scripts.text: I can manage it on my own.
I don't want to go with you.
I can manage her on my own.
If you have something to say, say it after we get out of the forest.
scripts.translation: 有什么话，等我们离开森林后再说。

scripts.text: I don't want to go with you.
If you have something to say, say it after we get out of the forest.
scripts.translation: 有什么话，等我们离开森林后再说。

scripts.text: You see a girl with mysterious hair collapsed on the ground.
scripts.translation: 你看到一个头发奇异的女孩倒在地上。

scripts.text: As you approach her, you smell the scent of flowers so strong that it makes you dizzy.
scripts.translation: 你靠近她时，闻到浓烈的花香，熏得你头晕目眩。

scripts.text: I'm too tired to talk to you.
scripts.translation: 我太累了，没力气和你说话。

scripts.text: I'm still confused, but I know what I did wrong.
scripts.translation: 我仍然很困惑，但我知道自己错在哪里。

scripts.text: If it weren't for you, I would still be wandering in the abyssal darkness.
scripts.translation: 如果不是你，我现在仍会在深渊般的黑暗中徘徊。

scripts.text: I thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
I'm ashamed of myself, falling for the sweet but empty words that came to me in my loneliness.
scripts.translation: 我为自己感到羞愧，竟在孤独时被那些甜蜜却空洞的话语所迷惑。

scripts.text: I don't deserve to be a guardian any more.
scripts.translation: 我已经不配再当守护者了。

scripts.text: A dragon gone crazy is not a guardian any more.
scripts.translation: 发狂的龙已不再是守护者。
我还以为自己被抛弃了...

scripts.text: The Guardian slowly looked away as if deep in thought.
scripts.translation: 守护者缓缓移开目光，似乎陷入了沉思。

scripts.text: - He seems to be deep in thought. -
I haven't gotten all of my powers back.
scripts.translation: 我的力量还没有完全恢复。

scripts.text: I'm sorry I can't protect you.
that I won't cry from loneliness again,
scripts.translation: 我不会再因孤独而哭泣，

scripts.text: that I will always have new friends like you...
scripts.translation: 而且会一直遇到像你这样的新朋友...

scripts.text: ...I've lost everything, but I'm happy now.
scripts.translation: ...我失去了一切，但现在我很幸福。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to do this quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏太满了，无法执行此任务。-

scripts.text: He won't look at you. It's like he's not interested at all.
scripts.translation: 他不愿看你一眼。看起来他对你毫无兴趣。

scripts.text: So you've passed through the forest.
scripts.translation: 看来你已经穿过森林了。

scripts.text: It seems Niddy has something to say to you.
scripts.translation: 妮蒂似乎有话要对你说。

scripts.text: Nydhogg was one of the guardians of the World Tree.
scripts.translation: 尼德霍格曾是世界树的守护者之一。

scripts.text: But he abandoned his duties as a guardian when he gave in to Morocc's temptation.
scripts.translation: 但他屈服于梦罗克的诱惑，放弃了守护者的职责。

scripts.text: Some fools performed a ritual to break the seal that held Morocc.
scripts.translation: 一些愚蠢之徒举行仪式，试图打破封印梦罗克的封印。

scripts.text: But the ritual didn't work right. The servant of Morocc failed to break the seal.
scripts.translation: 但仪式出了差错，梦罗克的仆从没能破开封印。

scripts.text: But the seal is so weak that it can break open any time.
scripts.translation: 不过封印已经十分脆弱，随时可能破裂。

scripts.text: It's Yggdrasil the World Tree's will that has kept the seal from breaking.
scripts.translation: 是世界树尤克特拉希尔的意志阻止了封印破裂。

scripts.text: That's right. The power of the World Tree is linked to the whole world.
scripts.translation: 没错，世界树的力量与整个世界相连。

scripts.text: When the bond between the guardians and Yggdrasil broke, Yggdrasil became unstable.
scripts.translation: 守护者与尤克特拉希尔之间的联系断裂后，世界树变得不稳定。

scripts.text: That's why all those disasters happened to Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 这就是世界树遭遇那些灾难的原因。

scripts.text: As the World Tree became unstable, the influence it had on the seal grew weak.
scripts.translation: 随着世界树逐渐不稳，它对封印的影响也越来越弱。

scripts.text: And Morocc broke himself free from the seal.
scripts.translation: 于是梦罗克挣脱了封印。

scripts.text: Although it seems like he used most of his powers just to break the seal...
scripts.translation: 不过，他似乎为了打破封印就耗尽了大部分力量...

scripts.text: I couldn't break free from Morocc's temptation.
scripts.translation: 我没能摆脱梦罗克的诱惑。

scripts.text: ...I wanted to be relieved of my thousands of years of loneliness.
I wasn't in my right mind then.
It was none other than I that broke my bond with Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 正是我亲手斩断了与尤克特拉希尔的联系。

scripts.text: I lost control of myself, and did what I shouldn't have done.
scripts.translation: 我失去了理智，做了不该做的事。

scripts.text: The other side of me became a shadow and a reckless tyrant.
scripts.translation: 我内心的另一面化作阴影，成了肆意妄为的暴君。
面对这个世界时，我才意识到...

scripts.text: I felt too great a sense of loss... it was much more painful than the loneliness I had endured for thousands of years.
scripts.translation: 我感受到巨大的失落...那比我忍受数千年的孤独还要痛苦。

scripts.text: That's how I was left alone.
scripts.translation: 就这样，我被独自留了下来。

scripts.text: I felt too great a sense of loss... it was much more painful than the loneliness I had endured for thousands of years.
scripts.translation: 我感受到巨大的失落...那比我忍受数千年的孤独还要痛苦。

scripts.text: So I became a sinner, forgotten to the world.
scripts.translation: 于是我成了被世界遗忘的罪人。

scripts.text: You still have things to do.
...Oh, yes. It's late, but I have to fulfill my duties as a guardian.
scripts.translation: ...啊，是的。虽然迟了，但我必须履行守护者的职责。

scripts.text: Now I know. I'll destroy Morocc with my own hands.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。我要亲手消灭梦罗克。

scripts.text: I will fulfill my duties as a guardian.
scripts.translation: 我会履行守护者的职责。

scripts.text: It may be why I haven't been forsaken - to realize that I'm not alone.
scripts.translation: 或许我没有被抛弃，是为了让我明白自己并不孤单。

scripts.text: I don't have to fight the loneliness any more.
scripts.translation: 我再也不必独自对抗孤独了。

scripts.text: Thanks for listening to my long story.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你听我说了这么久。

scripts.text: It's what I always have with me.
scripts.translation: 这是我一直随身带着的东西。

scripts.text: I'm sure it will protect you someday.
scripts.translation: 我相信总有一天它会保护你。

scripts.text: (Removes his scarf from around his neck and hands it to you.)
scripts.translation: （他取下脖子上的围巾，递给你。）

scripts.text: May the blessing of Mother Yggdrasil be with you...
scripts.translation: 愿世界树母亲的祝福与你同在...

scripts.text: I'll be staying here for a while.
The day when Morocc reveals his despicable nature...
scripts.translation: 等到梦罗克露出卑劣本性之日...

scripts.text: I will be waiting for him.
It's a giant flower with mysterious energy.
scripts.translation: 这是一朵蕴含神秘能量的巨大花朵。

scripts.text: It's reacting to the Mysterious Flower Seeds you have with you.
scripts.translation: 它正对你带着的神秘花种产生反应。

scripts.text: The flower started to shake violently
and swing forward as if trying to send the seeds as far away as possible!!!
scripts.translation: 并向前摆动，仿佛想把种子尽可能远地甩出去！！！

scripts.text: As you hold onto the Mysterious Flower Seeds tightly,
the flower shook violently and then became calm again.
scripts.translation: 花朵剧烈震动了一阵，随后又恢复了平静。

scripts.text: It looks like it has some special use, but you're not sure what.
scripts.translation: 它看起来似乎有特殊用途，但你不确定是什么。
